name: BeatDown
summary:
# Every song is a round. Every beat is a punch.

BeatDown puts you toe-to-toe with an opponent who fights to the music. Read the cues, dodge the swing, and hit back on the beat. Chain your hits to build your multiplier, then end the song with a finisher combo that sends your opponent flying.

## Fight to the music
Targets and dodges land on the beat of every track. The harder you swing, the bigger the hit, from a weak **PFFT** to a full **KAPOW**.
